caveats.en: Riot lists x64 as the required OS architecture and needs the Vanguard anti-cheat setup (TPM 2.0, Secure Boot). On RTX Spark the Vanguard driver refuses to install. Riot has not given an Arm date.
caveats.zh-TW: Riot 規定作業系統架構須為 x64，並需要 Vanguard 反作弊環境（TPM 2.0、安全開機）。在 RTX Spark 上 Vanguard 驅動程式無法安裝。Riot 尚未公布 Arm 支援時程。
